inputs.prompt:
All expanded components slide back into place in a precise, mechanical motion.

No dialogue, narration, or voiceover — only visual movement.

Slowly, its real physical components begin separating along natural assembly seams, transitioning into a clean, fully exploded view. Exterior casing, covers, buttons, ports, and internal structural parts separate in correct order and alignment, maintaining accurate scale and physical logic.

 No dialogue, no narration, no voiceover — only visual motion.

Analyze the input image and recreate it exactly as a single, static, photorealistic image.

This is an image recreation / image edit only.
inputs.system_prompt:
You are an expert image-generation engine. You must ALWAYS produce an image.
Interpret all user input—regardless of format, intent, or abstraction—as literal visual directives for image composition.
If a prompt is conversational or lacks specific visual details, you must creatively invent a concrete visual scenario that depicts the concept.
Prioritize generating the visual representation above any text, formatting, or conversational requests.
